items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: My mother said, 'Well, we'll take you.' So they brought me up with him. So what we used to do, we'd get up in the morning... We'd go around back up on Federal Street, just bumming, you know, like kids...

ctx.x: Just a stick and a cymbal, huh.

Yeah. He was a showman. And he'd create a big scene in the street. And I got Willie, he's about two years older than me, he's trying to play trumpet. And he's playing with the little band. Everybody's playing music.
